name: Drearia
description: Drearia was an Inner Rim world situated on the Hydian Way hyperlane. Sharing its name with the Drearian Defense Conglomerate, Drearia was a member of the Galactic Republic and later the Galactic Empire, for which it served as a fortress world. The world saw two clashes between Imperial and New Republic forces during the Galactic Civil War, and, in 10 ABY, the Mandator III-class dreadnought Aculeus was lost at Drearia due to Imperial in-fighting.
